summary: The note describes the 1982 European Cup Final, played on 26 May 1982 at De Kuip in Rotterdam, Netherlands. English club Aston Villa beat West German league winners Bayern Munich 1-0. The win gave Aston Villa its first and, so far, only European Cup, and extended a run of English victories in the competition to six consecutive years.
one_line: Aston Villa beat Bayern Munich 1-0 at De Kuip in Rotterdam on 26 May 1982 to win their only European Cup.
key_facts: The 1982 European Cup Final was played on 26 May 1982.
The match was played at De Kuip in Rotterdam, Netherlands.
English champions Aston Villa defeated West German league winners Bayern Munich 1-0 in the final.
Aston Villa won the European Cup for the first time in the club's history.
As of the note, Aston Villa's 1982 win was the only European Cup victory the club had achieved.
The 1982 win was the sixth consecutive European Cup victory by an English side.
The result continued a streak of English teams winning the competition.
Aston Villa were described as English champions in the note.
Bayern Munich were described as West German league winners in the note.
The final was decided by a single goal, giving a 1-0 scoreline.
